components.name: Neumorphic Flat Card
components.description: Extruded container card with soft top-left highlight and bottom-right shadow.
components.css: .ds-neu-card { background: #E0E5EC; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: -6px -6px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 6px 6px 10px rgba(163,177,198,0.45); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-neu-card-title { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #718096; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-neu-card-val { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #171C21; }

components.name: Neumorphic Convex Primary Button
components.description: Tactile convex gradient button that presses inward on click.
components.css: .ds-neu-btn { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #F5F8FC, #CAD1DC); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #2563EB; box-shadow: -4px -4px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 4px 4px 8px rgba(163,177,198,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-neu-btn:hover { box-shadow: -2px -2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 2px 2px 4px rgba(163,177,198,0.5); transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Neumorphic Pressed Input Well
components.description: Recessed inset well for numerical input and slider controls.

components.css: .ds-neu-input-well { background: #E0E5EC; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; box-shadow: inset -3px -3px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.35), inset 3px 3px 6px rgba(163,177,198,0.45); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-neu-input-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #718096; } .ds-neu-input-field { background: transparent; border: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #171C21; text-align: right; width: 60px; outline: none; }

narrative.overview: This system embodies a sophisticated Mono-Soft Neumorphic aesthetic, characterized by soft, extruded surfaces, recessed input wells, and a monochromatic ton-sur-ton palette. Built for mobile financial analysts, e-commerce founders, and venture investors, the brand personality is technical yet organic, aiming to eliminate visual fatigue through simulated light physics rather than harsh structural borders or loud saturated fills.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Depth Physics: Surfaces raise (neuFlat), press inward (neuPressed), convex bulge (neuConvex), or concave bevel (neuConcave) through multi-directional soft dual shadows.
Monochromatic Serenity: Primary palette centered on mid-gray-blue #E0E5EC (Light) and slate dark #171C21 / #1E232B (Dark) to keep dense data readable.
Instrument-Cluster Precision: Crisp Inter typography with wide uppercase tracking for metadata and dense numerical metrics.
Dual-Locale Harmony: Universal layout geometry seamlessly mirroring across English (LTR) and Kurdish Sorani (RTL).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Primary cobalt accent is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Elevation and depth, not loud color, dictate structural hierarchy.

rules.name: The Instrument Tracking Rule
rules.body: All auxiliary labels and uppercase metadata must use explicit tracking (0.2em) to evoke physical instrument cluster displays.

rules.name: The Soft Lighting Rule
rules.body: Light source is locked at top-left (-45° angle). All extruded surfaces push down-right shadows and reflect top-left highlights uniformly.

dos: Do maintain a consistent 45° top-left light source for all Neumorphic shadow offsets.
Do allow at least 24px-40px vertical breathing room between adjacent Neumorphic cards so shadows never collide.
Do use neuPressed for inset input fields and active toggle states.
Do support both LTR and RTL directionality natively using Jetpack Compose CompositionLocalProvider.
donts: Don't use hard 1px black stroke borders around cards or buttons; rely on Neumorphic light physics for separation.
Don't flood surfaces with high-saturation background colors; keep canvas surfaces monochromatic #E0E5EC or #171C21.
Don't mix conflicting light angles across different components on the same screen.
